tools.name: compare_thai_bank_rates
tools.description: Compare current Thai bank TT rates for one currency. Use side=selling when paying THB to buy foreign currency (lower is better), and side=buying when receiving THB from foreign currency (higher is better).

tools.name: get_best_thai_fx_rate
tools.description: Return the current best Thai bank TT rate for one currency and direction.

tools.name: get_thai_fx_history
tools.description: Return historical TT rates for one Thai bank and currency. History is stored observations and may not contain a point for every hour.

tools.name: list_thai_fx_banks
tools.description: List banks available in Thai FX Compare with stored currencies and latest quote time.
